en.html:
Even as I spoke, I fed <ruby>heat<rt>fire</rt></ruby> into the Gattari.

Output: about half the limit. Even that was far too much indoors—but let it be.

Abrupt ignition. <ruby>Exhaust<rt>Exhaust</rt></ruby>. Forced to provide thrust by such brute means, every plate on my body <ruby>shuddered<rt>shuddered</rt></ruby>.

And forward I went—
Only forward.

No technique. Not even a raised sword.

<ruby>I had already lost, after all<rt>・・・・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>—what need had I of technique now!

en.html:
I launched forward on thrust that was, quite literally, explosive. Jouansai Yagyuu caught that first instant perfectly, and his sword came for me.

Only an ordinary sword. Yet in this strange-looking man's hands it was precisely enough of a weapon to enter any joint in a warrior's armor and inflict a grave wound.
But—

To make a single stroke fatal, he had only one target: the neck.
The heart was impossible. A sword-armor's chest was thick plate, its blade-resistant structure calculated to the last detail. It could turn aside even a warrior's thrust.

Therefore, the neck.
The neck alone had to be protected.

ja.html:
文字通り爆発的な推力を得て進発する。
　その出端を見事に捉えて、柳生常闇斎の一剣は俺を
襲った。

　ただの刀に過ぎぬそれはしかし、この異相の男の手
にある限り、武者の全身にある関節部から潜り込んで
重傷を負わせ得る過不足ない凶器たる。
　が――

　一撃を以て致命傷を与えようと思うならそれはただ
一箇所、首を狙うほかにない。
　心臓は無理だ。分厚い甲鉄が計算し尽くされた耐刃
構造をとる劒冑の胸部は、武者の刺突でも跳ね除ける。

　だから、首。
　首さえ守ればいい。

en.html:
Jouansai's murderous blade precisely <ruby>caught<rt>seized</rt></ruby> the gap at the elbow of my shielding left arm and entered. It cut freely through skin into flesh, flesh into bone. The work of a superhuman hand.
Fear froze my blood; admiration stopped my breath.

But even the head of the Yagyuu could go no further. Having cut through Muramasa's left arm, the stroke lost its force, struck the helmet horn and bounced lightly away.

en.html:
No matter the details.
I went only forward.

Entrusting myself to thrust that seemed to leave the whole world behind, forward————
My shoulder met Jouansai's chest and, in an instant, sent him backward.

I could tell that even this collision had done the monstrous master no harm. At the instant of contact he had leaned backward himself, letting the impact pass.
But that did not matter.

I did not even look at the opponent who had presumably fallen. I raced through, half <ruby>in flight<rt>flying</rt></ruby>. Only forward.

There was no longer anything in my path.

ja.html:
委細、構わず。
　俺はただ前へ進む。

　世界全てを置き去りにするが如き推力に身を任せ、
前方へ――――
　肩が常闇斎の胸元に接し。そして一瞬のうちに押し
飛ばした。

　この激突さえ、怪物じみた達人に何の痛痒も与えて
いないのがわかる――接触の瞬間自ら体を後方へ倒し、
衝撃を流している。
　しかし、構わない。

　倒れたであろう敵手に、俺は目も向けなかった。
　駆け抜ける。半ばは<ruby>騎航して<rt>とんで</rt></ruby>。ただ前へ。

　行く手を妨げるものは、最早何も無かった。
